text:
maya: Quick heads-up — opened a docs PR to migrate the Console observability dashboard examples and update the tracing-hook SDK snippets. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234. Needs: smoke test, link fixes, and a short note about cost/latency breakdowns.
jon: Thanks — will take a look after standup. Do you want the cost example to show per-route token breakdown or just overall per-model?
maya: Per-route preferred (helps platform teams). Keep overall as fallback. Also need note about required SDK versions for trace hook changes.
kevin: I can audit the SDK snippets (node + python). Saw one embed that uses an old param `trace_id` — new API expects `trace.context`.
lina: CI flagged a broken internal link in the dashboard embed example `../assets/dash-embed.png`. I'll send a quick patch to fix the relative path.
docs-bot: build/checker: link-checker failed on PR 1234 — 1 broken link (../assets/dash-embed.png). Full log: https://ci.internal/reports/1234
jon: For the cost/latency snippet I suggest showing a small sample table and a code snippet that pulls per-route metrics. Example inline: ```js
// get cost per route
const metrics = await client.metrics.list({route: '/api/generate', window: '1h'});
console.log(metrics.token_cost_breakdown);
```
kevin: Also call out SDK >= 2.3.0 for `trace.context` helpers, otherwise include a short migration note: `if (sdkVersion < '2.3.0') use fallbackTraceId()`
lina: Pushed link-fix commit (force-pushed to branch). CI green for link-checker now.
maya: Nice — can someone re-run the preview and eyeball the dashboard screenshots? I updated captions to mention latency SLOs and KV cache effects.
jon: Rerunning preview now. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1234--redwood-docs.netlify.app/console/observability/migration (will update thread when done)
docs-bot: preview-deploy: deploy-preview-1234 is ready — https://deploy-preview-1234--redwood-docs.netlify.app/console/observability/migration
kevin: Preview looks good overall, but the Node snippet still includes legacy `traceHook()` import style. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to replace with `import { startTrace } from '@redwood/trace'` to match README.
maya: Perfect. Once kevin's tiny PR lands and we have an extra LGTM from @jon I'll merge. Thanks everyone — keeping this small made the migration smooth. :tada:
